##: Extracts the official Inno Setup payload; the vendor installer is not executed.
description: Offline-first Windows wallpaper manager with scheduled changes, hotkeys, multi-monitor support, and a tray picker.
notes: The installer’s initial launch and startup-registration tasks are not run. Launch walld.exe from the shortcut; enable Start with Windows from the tray menu if needed. Settings and wallpaper data remain under %APPDATA%\WallpaperPicker after Scoop uninstall.
